title: Fixed Open Hood and Radial Card Viewer
description: One newly authored complete hand-cranked radial-card viewing-device appearance in a deliberately open-front cutaway pose. A full broad ground pedestal and lower cabinet carry two side bearing uprights, one continuous horizontal axle and a complete root cylinder with twenty-four independently thick blank radial cards. A thick curved rear housing has fully modeled cut edges rather than invisible missing polygons. Separate rooted side stays carry one true rectangular through-open viewing hood above the front of the card pack. A complete side crank and grip belong to the same axis. Unlike the old slotted vertical-axis viewing drum, there is no enclosing open-top cylinder, ring picture strip or circumferential slit field. Unlike the old pinned-cylinder music box, there is no comb, pin array or hinged case lid: the broad radial card pack and front viewing hood define this whole apparatus. All numeric geometry newly authored, no old model imported. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metre Z up and horizontal full-bounds-centred ground origin. One complete static prop zero scenes. Generic mutoscope-inspired exhibition exterior, not a historical replica: cards are intentionally blank, no film frames, verified sight line, lens optics, card-release mechanism, timed flip, motion, projected imagery, animation effect, coin operation, manufacture, load or equipment safety. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
